drift.title: The process runs a different config
drift.description: The running sing-box has {{running}} rules, while the applied file has {{document}}. The rule number is not shown: it would point into a document the process never read.
drift.notCompared: The applied config was not read, so there is nothing to compare the process rule list with — there is no jump to the node.

origin.note: «From core» means data from the running sing-box. The panel does not compute why the rules above did not match: it does not reimplement rule semantics, and the arbiter of the route is the binary.

final.title: No rule matched
final.description: The traffic went to route.final — the default outcome, not a missed rule.

unknown.title: The rule is undetermined
unknown.missing: The rule of this connection is not in the process list.
unknown.drifted: The process rule list diverged from the applied config, there is nothing to determine the node with.

reason.not_in_process_list: the rule of this connection is not in the running process list

matched.title: Rule {{number}} matched
matched.open: Open the rule in the editor
